newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank cuts tender rate to 3.10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank cuts tender rate to 3.10 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Finland said on Wednesday it was lowering its tender rate, the key tool of monetary policy, to 3.10 percent from 3.25 percent.
"The Bank of Finland has decided to cut the bank's tender rate from 3.25 percent to 3.10 percent. The decision is effective immediately," the central bank said.
"Behind the rate cut are a continued moderate inflation outlook, the narrowing spread between domestic and foreign market interest rates and the confidence shown towards the markka," it said.
A spokesman said the bank would give further comments at a news conference at 1300/1000 GMT where its latest economic review is released.
Its last move was to lower the tender rate on August 23, a cut of 25 basis points. The latest cut brings the key rate down by 290 basis points since October 1995.
